job.title: Software Developer – Microsoft Access (VBA), SQL Server & C#
job.content:
Virginia Nursery Pty Ltd | Virginia, South Australia


Love Programming, Solving Problems and Developing Better Systems? We’d Love to Hear From You!

Virginia Nursery Pty Ltd is looking for an experienced and enthusiastic Software Developer to join our growing team.

If you enjoy improving existing software, developing new features and finding smarter ways for technology to support a business, this could be an exciting opportunity for you.

We’re looking for someone with strong Microsoft Access, VBA and SQL Server experience who can help us continue developing our existing business applications, while also contributing to future software projects involving C# and .NET.

This is a hands-on role where your ideas, experience and technical skills can make a genuine difference.


About Us

Virginia Nursery Pty Ltd is a well-established, family-owned South Australian business, home to one of Australia’s largest garden centres, along with extensive plant production and wholesale nursery operations.

As our business continues to grow and diversify, we are constantly investing in technology, automation and internally developed software to improve the way we operate.

Our software systems play an important role across our various business divisions, and we have many exciting improvements and development projects planned.

We believe technology should make business operations easier, more efficient and more productive, and we’re looking for someone who shares that vision.


The Role

This is a varied and rewarding position involving software programming, database development, system improvements and general IT support.

Our immediate priority is the continued development and enhancement of our existing Microsoft Access applications, which are integrated with SQL Server databases.

We have a range of improvements, new features and automation projects planned and are looking for someone who enjoys taking existing software systems to the next level.

Looking ahead, we also plan to expand our software capabilities through the development of new applications using C# and .NET technologies.

You’ll work closely with management to understand business requirements, identify opportunities for improvement and develop practical, reliable software solutions.


What You’ll Be Doing

  • Developing, maintaining and enhancing existing Microsoft Access applications using VBA.

  • Designing and implementing new features, forms, reports and automated processes.

  • Working with Microsoft SQL Server databases, including queries, stored procedures and performance optimisation.

  • Troubleshooting existing software and improving system reliability and efficiency.

  • Identifying opportunities to streamline business processes through software development and automation.

  • Assisting with the planning and development of future applications using C# and .NET.

  • Integrating new technologies and applications with existing business systems.

  • Providing general IT support, including computer troubleshooting, software, hardware and basic networking.

  • Working directly with management and staff to develop practical solutions to everyday business challenges.


What We’re Looking For

We’re looking for someone who is confident in their programming abilities, enjoys problem-solving and takes pride in developing software that works.

Ideally, you’ll bring:

  • Strong experience in Microsoft Access development, including VBA programming, forms, reports and queries.

  • Solid knowledge of Microsoft SQL Server, including database design, SQL queries and optimisation.

  • Experience with C# programming and .NET application development would be highly regarded.

  • Experience integrating Microsoft Access applications with SQL Server databases.

  • Good general IT knowledge, including Windows, Microsoft Office, computer hardware and networking.

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.

  • The ability to work independently, manage projects and communicate effectively.

A proactive attitude and genuine interest in improving business systems.

Most importantly, we’re looking for someone who enjoys a challenge, takes initiative and is enthusiastic about developing practical software solutions.


Why Join Virginia Nursery?

Interesting & Varied Projects – Work on a wide range of software development projects, from improving existing applications to helping introduce new technologies.

Your Ideas Will Be Valued – Work directly with management, contribute your own ideas and see the results of your work in everyday business operations.

Flexible Working Arrangements – We understand the importance of flexibility and are happy to discuss suitable working hours and arrangements with the right applicant.

Long-Term Career Opportunities – Join an established and expanding business that continues to invest in technology, automation and software development.

Friendly & Supportive Workplace – Become part of a welcoming, family-owned business where your contribution is genuinely appreciated.


Interested? Let’s Have a Chat!

Whether you’re actively looking for a new position or currently employed and simply interested in exploring a different opportunity, we’d love to hear from you.

We understand that changing jobs is an important decision. If you’re unsure whether this position is right for you, please feel welcome to contact our recruitment team for a confidential discussion about the role and the projects we have planned.

To apply, please send your resume and a brief outline of your programming experience to:

careers@virginianursery.com.au

We look forward to hearing from you and discussing how you could become part of the Virginia Nursery team!
